reviews.t: Works very well for sealing n95's to your face.
reviews.x: I use this to glue n95 respirators onto my face. I work directly with covid patients and some of the new styles of respirators slide around on my face. This keeps it sealed on for the entire shift and if I need a drink of water I can peel it off partially and it will reseal itself afterwards.

My daughters wedding was this weekend . I had lost some weight prior to the wedding which altered the top of the dress a bit . Not so big that it looked awful but I did not want to wear a strapless bra nor did I want the bra straps to show . This tape did the trick. I actually adhered the back of the dress to the bra straps and that did the trick for the entire 8’hoirs I had the dress on and I am relatively sure it would have stayed in place another 8 hours of not longer . I wish I would have taken a picture.  First, the packaging was nothing like this.  I received a smoky black plastic tape dispenser in a baggie.  The tape was so tight and in that holder that it wouldn't even unroll for use.  I had to break apart the plastic to get to the tape (and that plastic was thick and sharp when it broke!).  When I finally did get to it, the tape was difficult to use.  Put it on skin first - impossible to easily get the paper off the other side.  Take the paper off first -

reviews.t: Strong to cloth, soft to skin
reviews.x: With this tape  I paste a filter made with paper towel under a cloth mask . It is strong to the cloth and I didnt felt in my cheek.  Many uses for the corona virus time.

[[VIDEOID:3ac10b198c43366584c7b3211436019e]] The adhesive does not come off once it goes on! I tried to peel the tape off after using it to stick some fabric of my new dress together temporarily for a party. I tried to peel off the tape but most of it stayed! It completely ruined my expensive new dress, I’m so upset.

reviews.t: I can't get the adhesive off my clothes
reviews.x: This is a nightmare.  I used it to keep a button-down shirt closed.  At the end of the day, the adhesive would not come off one side of the fabric.  Ruined my top.
Tape mask to my face for work procedure. Easy take off and put on.
I have narrow shoulders so my bra straps always show if I wear anything with a wide neckline.  I used this to attach my too to my bra straps...worked perfectly and didn't come loose!

Highly recommend!!! One of my tops reveals way too much cleavage and I was looking for a product to help cover up. Package does look different from the picture but it’s the same thing. It adheres well even after a wash. Once this tape is on it’s hard to get off so I wouldn’t recommend it on delicate or lacy fabrics. Other than that 5 stars. I’ll be purchasing again.

Item works well for what I needed. However, it was packaged quite differently, although the imprint on the tape dispenser says Scotch 3M. The description did not mention that the roll is actually cut so not full width easily. This discrepancy is why I took off one star.

reviews.t: Cling It2: strong tape, excellent value
reviews.x: I use this tape to keep my face mask in place during the day at work. I wear glasses, and having the mask bridge fixed is really helpful. The Cling It2 double-sided tape is strong enough to stay in place for hours.

reviews.t: Hold fabric where you want itn
reviews.x: Hold fabric where you want it. Had bought it for my wedding and my bridesmaids used it and loved it.
Easy to use, holds nicely, removed easily when finished wearing it
This tape works great holding the garment to your skin

Este tape es bueno para fijar una tela que no quieres que se levante o se mueve,  pero para aguantar los pechos a mi no me funcionó,  soy 36DDD yno queria que mis pechos se me salieran del vestido y puse mucho tape en mi escote y el vestido , nada se quedó en menos de 5 minutos estaba desperado. El tape es bueno y pega muy fuerte pero es muy fino, pienso que deben vender una version de 2 o 3 pulgadas para las que tenemos senos mas grandes.

The hem came loose on my shorts in a small spot, two pieces of this tape fixed the problem instead of lugging my sewing machine out. The tape has lasted through the summer with many washes! It also holds together a sweater where the top button is just a little too low cut.

Most masks leave gaps on my skinny little face.  This product is great to add protection by gently sealing the gaps.  Can't speak to ease of removal from mask as single-use masks are thrown away, but it does remove easily from skin.

reviews.t: Hope its good for no tie face masks
reviews.x: I got this to make no tie disposable face masks for friends to use at the beauty shop. I like the idea that I can be more exact with the length of the tapes. Haven’t tried it yet . I hope it’s not to sticky for sensitive faces.

My daughter used this tape to keep her staples prom gown up. She even stepped on her gown several times and it still stayed up. I will say her skin was red when we removed the tape but that did not last more than a day.
It was just what I needed to keep my Christmas low cut Christmas Party dress in place. Be sure you use on clean dry skin!
Using to keep my cloth mask taped down so my glasses don't fog up. Works great.
Justo lo que estaba buscando, buen producto

Best purchase ever! I always struggle with my bra straps moving all over the place and this double sided sticky tape helps keep them in place all day. Also its hard to see in the picture but it's already perforated so no scissors needed. It even has a perforated line down the middle in case you only want a strip half as thick. Honestly don't walk, but run to buy this product while it's on sale.

I used it on my bra strap because they always slip down on my left shoulder. The tape is very sticky, hurts to remove.  I seem to have a bad reaction to whatever they are made of, left a sore spot which is still there days later. I won't be using it on my skin again but double stick tape is handy for other things.
This tape is the strongest tape I've used and doesn't hurt my sensitive skin, however has pulled the stitching out of a couple facemasks and takes running under hot water to remove from them.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the tape holds fabric and masks in place effectively for hours, including during work shifts and events.
Several reviewers report the adhesive is very strong and hard to remove, sometimes ruining clothing.
Some reviewers note the packaging received differs from the product picture.
A few reviewers mention the tape works well for securing face masks.
One reviewer found it did not hold up for supporting a large bust.
